messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — Zen8 (retainer account) wants to onboard a custom reranker for their catalog search. They want a private 13B deploy with HSM KMS, PHI redaction, and a safety/regression eval before we flip traffic. Renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks so this is time-sensitive; if eval slips we may surface renewal risk. Who can own tech coordination and the eval?

Tom: Linking the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard-checklist. @Rohit can you take ML evals? Also need an owner for private deployment tasks. Do they already have a prompt set or labeled relevance data?

Rohit: I can run the initial safety + regression suite. Need: sample prompts (~200), label schema for relevance, and a short description of failure modes they care about. Note: HSM + private control plane adds ~2-3 weeks for infra + key provisioning, depends on Zen8's security team turnaround. Also need token distribution (median + 95th pct).

Marta: I'll own enablement and customer training — can prep a short runbook and a 30-min enablement call. Recommend a canary rollout plan: start at 5% traffic, monitor MRR/latency, auto-fallback to hosted reranker if error rate >2% or latency >1s P95.

Aisha: I will ask Zen8 for prompts, labels, and the security contact for KMS. Renewal rep wants a go/no-go in 4 weeks — if we don't start evals in 10 days we should mark renewal risk.

Rohit: Proposed eval suite to run once we have data:
```
eval_suite: reranker-zen8-initial
samples: 200
metrics: mrr, ndcg@10, latency_p95, hallucination_rate
safety_checks: pii_detection, phi_redaction, toxic_language
```
I'll kick off smoke runs and post results. If they need additional privacy tests (k-anon or synthetic leakage) flag it now.

eval-bot: new eval job queued: JOB-8791 for zen8 — awaiting data upload to s3://zen8-onboard/inputs.

Tom: :thumbsup: noted. I'll update the account health status and add a "needs-eval" tag. If samples not uploaded by next Tues, I'll flag renewal risk as PROBABLE.

Aisha: Thanks — I'll follow up with Zen8 today and update this thread when I have their assets or timelines.
